relics.title: Bone-Bronze Splinter
relics.epitaph: A saint's knuckle cast in dull bronze. Still cold.

relics.title: Bell-Tongue Shard
relics.epitaph: Broken clapper metal. It rings once when no one listens.

relics.title: Martyr-Cloth Thread
relics.epitaph: Frayed linen from a shroud. Smells faintly of myrrh.

relics.title: Choir Ash
relics.epitaph: Ash from candles that burned through a night of siege.

relics.title: Pulpit Key-Tooth
relics.epitaph: A filed key bit that once raised the Devout into the tower.

relics.title: Vestry Iron Nail
relics.epitaph: Hand-forged. Driven into oak that outlived three wars.

relics.title: Scar Fragment
relics.epitaph: Black glass from a blister in the earth. It ticks when demons near.

relics.title: Rose Shard of St Paul
relics.epitaph: A fragment of the great window, still warm with prayer.

relics.title: Coronation Splinter
relics.epitaph: Oak from a chair of kings. It will not burn clean.

relics.title: River Nail of Southwark
relics.epitaph: Salt-eaten iron. Driven when the Thames still flooded the nave.

relics.title: Becket Letter-Shard
relics.epitaph: Vellum scraped thin. The ink is blood that dried into scripture.

relics.title: Harbour Bell-Tongue
relics.epitaph: Bronze from St Nicholas. It called ships and Cathedrons alike.

relics.title: Parish Seal
relics.epitaph: Wax and thread. Proof you stood where a shell still sleeps.

relics.title: Cathedral Seal
relics.epitaph: Heavier wax. The Devout mark of a true Cathedron husk.
